name: Past-Due Ratio
summary: 41% of AR is past due ($31,747,331). It concentrates in higher-risk tiers, a few large institutional segments, and dispute-blocked invoices.

drivers.name: Aging concentration
drivers.narrative: Where the past-due balance sits by age.
drivers.rootCause: The 61–90 and 90+ tail is dominated by acceptance / milestone disputes on systems and by slow public-sector payers.

drivers.name: Customer risk tier
drivers.narrative: Past-due exposure by customer risk tier.
drivers.rootCause: High-risk distributors and emerging-market accounts carry disproportionate past-due balances — candidates for proactive delinquency outreach.

drivers.name: Segment mix
drivers.narrative: Which institution types drive the past-due balance.
drivers.rootCause: Large hospital networks and academic centers batch-approve invoices on monthly cycles, creating predictable past-due bulges.

drivers.name: Dispute-blocked AR
drivers.narrative: $25,589,411 of receivables are blocked behind open disputes.
drivers.rootCause: Install-milestone and pricing disputes hold invoices open; faster dispute resolution releases this balance.
